# Code of Conduct

This is a small project maintained in spare time. To keep it a good place to take part, the following is expected from anyone who comments, opens an issue or sends a pull request:

- **Be respectful.** Disagreeing with an approach or a decision is fine; disrespecting the person who proposed it is not.
- **Be specific.** "This fails like this, in this browser, with these steps" helps far more than a general complaint.
- **Be patient.** The project is maintained out of personal interest, not as a full-time job, so replies may take a while.
- **Harassment, discriminatory comments and aggressive language** toward other people involved in the project are not tolerated.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit, close or remove issues, comments and pull requests that do not follow this code, and may block anyone who repeatedly breaks it. If you witness or experience something that does not fit this code, contact the maintainer through the channels on their [GitHub profile](https://github.com/filonux).
